notes.content:

[*] SUB. Under the desert, even dogs freeze
[*] SUB. Numb and Numbed! Battle for control!

notes.title: Additional downloadable content will be released after late April 2024!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing METAL DOGS.

We are happy to announce that March 24th marks the first anniversary of the release of METAL DOGS.
We are planning to implement some additional contents for your continued enjoyment!

[h2]◆Distribution of 1st Anniversary Items[/h2]
Special commemorative items will be given to players in the 3/25 update.

[h2]◆Additional DLC to be released[/h2]
New DLC will be released sequentially in late April and late May.

The first DLC will include additional quests!
New enemies and unique dropped equipment will be added along with the additional quests!

We will report the update schedule and other details as soon as they are finalized.

Thank you for your continued support of METAL DOGS.

notes.title: METAL DOGS Full Release
notes.content:
METAL DOGS, the first spin-off title in the METAL MAX series, is officially available for download on Steam starting today.

METAL DOGS is a special title created to commemorate the METAL MAX series' 30th  anniversary, celebrated in May 2021. This game was designed to allow a broader audience to experience the series with ease.
24Frame is the producer, developer, and publisher for Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®4, and Steam® through an official licensing agreement with Cygames, Inc.

An Early Access version of this game was released on Steam® on August 25, 2021 (JST). After a series of updates, the game became available for download worldwide on Nintendo Switch™ in early March 2023, and is now full release today on Steam®.

We look forward to your continued support of "METAL DOGS".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40064957/3a3223ea3a8627775a963bc21795ef818cea91bb.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.3.0 patch notes
notes.content:
[b]◆ Addition of new mode[/b]
[u]Add view mode[/u]
- It is a mode that you can see the appearance of your dogs from various angles.
- You can check it from "Dog View" in the Doghouse.
- Various backgrounds and frames will be added as the quest progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40064957/4550582623b72efeaed3c0f367b23383ce81baff.jpg[/img]

[u]◆ Addition of new costumes[/u]
- A new costume has been added that allows you to decorate your dogs.
- Hats and sunglasses such as straw hats, we have added the familiar "Metal barrel" of the Metal Max series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40064957/6c45113ede7af82a263f481c38898dfaa8dd017d.jpg[/img]

[u]◆ Addition of weapons for specific dogs[/u]
- Added new special equipment that can only be equipped by specific dogs.
- It is available at the exchange.

[u]◆ Addition of exchange[/u]
- It will be a facility where you can exchange items with the "Dog tag" that can be obtained in the dungeon.
- You can get powerful equipment and new costumes at the exchange.

[u]◆ Addition of automatic item acquisition function[/u]
- Not only money, but also ammunition, "Constituent Mutagens", "Dog tags", and "Super modified alloy" can now be obtained automatically when approaching.
- In addition, by pressing and holding the enter button, we have added a function that allows you to collect all the money and items that can be automatically acquired in the hierarchy.

[u]◆Bug Fix[/u]
- Fixed a bug where the S-E attack did not hit the front of the Rommel Ghost.
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from advancing in dungeons due to invisible walls.
- Fixed a bug where unintended items could be equipped when performing certain actions.
- Fixed a bug that the loading did not end at the time of quest sortie when performing a specific action.

[u]◆ Others[/u]
- Minor bug fixes
- Balance adjustment

notes.title: We will release the first update summary and director report # 1!
notes.content:
[b]■Tomono Director's "Metal Dogs" Director's Report # 1[/b]

　First of all, thank you for your participation and support for Early Access, which started on August 25th! We would like to thank you for your participation that exceeded our expectations.
　For future updates, we will post your opinions on the Metal Dogs Steam store page, as well as your opinions on Twitter and blogs, and we will read as much as possible every day.

[b]■Major future update policies[/b]
[list]
[*] １．"Realization of comfortable operability"
[/list]
　As a casual action game that can be enjoyed by a wide range of people, we will improve various operability. In addition, we will optimize the operation in the keyboard environment, which was often pointed out as insufficient.

[list]
[*] 2. "Expansion of response"
[/list]
　This time, in the Early Access version, we provided the entire game only in the so-called "easy mode", which focuses on the wide frontage, but we have prepared a high difficulty mode for customers who want a harder game experience. I will do it. We will also expand the game volume and variations.

[list]
[*] 3．"Strengthening the appeal of" dog game ""
[/list]
　We will expand the charm of dogs, which have been well received by many customers, so that their individuality will stand out and they will be loved.

[b]■Scheduled to be updated soon in September[/b] [i]* Detailed dates will be announced as soon as they are officially decided.[/i]
　In accordance with the above main update policy, we plan to implement the following functions.

[list]
[*] 1.	Improved comfort regarding item drop and acquisition process during quest
[/list]
　You used to have to wait a bit to get the dropped item from the enemy, but by adjusting the response, you can now get the item without breaking the rhythm of the gameplay.

[list]
[*] 2．Implementation of high difficulty "hard mode (provisional)" as a trial operation (please let us know your opinion)
[/list]
　We will additionally implement "Hard Mode (Tentative)" as a trial operation in order to realize "Rogue Light-like game characteristics" that are highly requested by users.
　In addition to the conventional "normal mode", we would appreciate it if you could enjoy it and give us your opinions.

　Until now, there was no penalty for death,but in "Hard Mode (Tentative)", various new rules are applied, such as losing all equipment, weapons, items, etc. that you had when you died.
Try the gameplay, which is much more tense.

[list]
[*] 3．Other minor bug fixes and data adjustments
[/list]

　We will continue to do our utmost to realize the more beloved "Metal Dogs", and we look forward to your continued patronage of "Metal Dogs".
